app.title: Smart Product Finder
home.tagline: Compare prices and CO₂e across Vietnamese stores
search.image.title: Search by image
search.image.subtitle: Drag and drop an image or choose one from your device.
product.co2ExplanationDisclaimer: This is an estimation of the carbon footprint (cradle-to-grave) based on similar products. It is not an exact measurement and may not be completely accurate.
product.co2NotSupported: CO₂e estimation is not supported for this product category (e.g. clothing, bags).
product.co2UnavailableTooltip: We were unable to estimate the carbon footprint for this specific item.
product.notEvaluatedReason: Carbon estimations are currently limited to high-impact tech categories (laptops, smartphones, monitors, tablets, earphones). Categories like clothes, bags, or other items do not have sufficient manufacturer Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs) for reliable estimation.
product.reasonEcoHighlyRated: Eco-friendly option with lower carbon footprint and excellent buyer rating ({rating}★).
product.reasonDiscount: Best value deal with a significant discount of {pct}% available on {platform_name}.
product.reasonHighlyRated: Top-rated seller selection with high customer satisfaction ({rating}★ from {reviews} reviews).
product.reasonBalanced: Balanced choice with competitive pricing and solid customer feedback.
assistant.title: Green product AI assistant
assistant.subtitle: Describe what you need by voice or typing. The AI finds products, draws comparison charts and tells you how much CO₂ you save after 6 months / 1 year of use.
assistant.placeholder: e.g. I need a 1 HP air conditioner for a bedroom, under 10 million VND, energy-saving. Compare CO₂ saved over 1 year.
assistant.loading: The AI is analysing your request, querying products and drawing charts...
assistant.error: Could not process the request right now. Please try again.
assistant.disclaimer: CO₂ figures are estimates from the system's lifecycle formula (Vietnam grid factor), not manufacturer-certified values.
assistant.saved: Saves {six} kg CO₂ after 6 months · {twelve} kg after 1 year
assistant.col.name: Product
product.greenScoreHint: Compared with products of the same type: 5 = lowest footprint, 0 = highest (range {low}–{high} kg).
product.co2SourceManufacturer: Manufacturer-published figure for this exact model
product.co2SourceAverage: Average of the most similar products with manufacturer figures
